payload.description: 64px crisp pixel art, transparent, top-down. Dry low bone heap, ~34x18px. 9-12 varied fragments, 4-8px each: curved chips, hollow snapped stubs, tiny joint knobs, flat flakes. Mix shapes, lengths, angles. Dirty ivory, taupe, purple-gray; 6-8 colors, selective outline, sparse shading. Composition: wide flat trapezoid. No skull, face, jaw, flesh, blood, floor, stones, whole long bones, identical dumbbells, pedestal, background.
